title: Compiler warnings as findings
summary: A warning the build enables is a finding only when the checks name it
prose: The compiler warnings a unit's command enables are findings when `Checks` lists their `clang-diagnostic-<flag>` name, reported under that name. The others stay out of the report.

value.stdout:
${WS}/main.cpp:2:9: warning: unused variable 'unused' [clang-diagnostic-unused-variable]
Linted 1 translation unit in #s: 1 finding.
